description: This file contains utility functions for list operations such as head, last, find, sum, and others, and exports them as a module. It is part of the Summernote editor's core list utilities.

methods.name: head
methods.description: Returns the first item of an array.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last item of an array.

methods.name: initial
methods.description: Returns all elements of an array except the last.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Returns all elements of an array except the first.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds and returns the first item in an array that satisfies the predicate.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Checks if all elements in an array pass the predicate test.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of an item in an array using jQuery's $.inArray.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an array contains a specific item.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of array elements, optionally using a provided function.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Converts a collection with a length property into an array.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if an array is empty or null.

methods.name: clusterBy
methods.description: Clusters array elements based on a predicate function.

methods.name: compact
methods.description: Removes falsey values from an array.

methods.name: unique
methods.description: Removes duplicate elements from an array.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next item in an array after the specified item.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Returns the previous item in an array before the specified item.
